channel.title: AI News Radar
channel.description: A curated 24-hour radar of AI news: official releases, new models and high-signal discussion.

item.title: Where scientists draw the line on AI agents
item.description: Ai2 interviewed 17 scientists to define five trust dimensions, including validation and privacy, for AI agents handling literature reviews and data analysis, stressing that researchers must still check for overlooked conflicting evidence, understand which methods and files an agent used, and protect privacy. (Hugging Face Blog)

item.title: Copilot code review billing will default to the organization
item.description: Copilot code review charges for licensed members will default to the organization starting December 30, 2026, affecting Copilot Business and Copilot Enterprise organizations and enterprises, which must select Member before then to keep billing unchanged. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: How to choose the next safe step in application modernization
item.description: Four public applications, from a Node.js mini-game to a large Java ERP app, demonstrate an evidence-first approach: build an evidence inventory, pick a bounded modernization step per component, and reuse the method as a GitHub Copilot agent skill. (GitHub AI & ML)

item.title: An Indic Voice Agent with CUGA
item.description: IBM Research built a CUGA-based Indic voice agent that lets farmers ask in Hindi, Tamil and other languages how to tell good seeds from bad, and switching from default English embeddings to intfloat/multilingual-e5-large lets one English document serve multiple languages. (Hugging Face Blog)

item.title: 10 AI variety shows are coming! Zhejiang TV brings in Seedance2.5 for program production
item.description: Zhejiang Satellite TV is partnering with Volcano Engine to produce a first batch of 10 AI variety shows, whose main episodes are already in production, using Seedance 2.5 to generate low-resolution sample footage. (AIbase)

item.title: Anthropic CEO denies handing over human free will to AI, warns of the risks of recursive self-improvement in models
item.description: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei used a November 25 post of more than 1,000 words, published six days after the company's November 19 IPO, to deny ceding human free will to AI and warn that recursive self-improvement could outpace human control. (AIbase)

item.title: Claude and ChatGPT Move Into Protein Structure Prediction as General-Purpose Models Challenge AlphaFold's Specialist Standing
item.description: Phylo researcher Xinming Tu tested OpenAI, Anthropic and Google large models on bacterial protein sequence prediction earlier this month, finding Claude outperformed rival models and specialized tools, while OpenAI said proteins designed by its new model partly matched expectations in synthesis tests. (AIbase)

item.title: OpenAI begins testing "private reasoning": isolating enterprise data while models run, so even internal employees can't view it
item.description: Sam Altman announced on November 26 that OpenAI is inviting select customers to test Private Inference, which uses confidential computing to isolate enterprise data during model runtime so even OpenAI employees cannot view it. (AIbase)

item.title: OpenAI begins testing "Private Reasoning": customer data is isolated while models run, and even internal staff can't view it
item.description: Sam Altman said on X that OpenAI has invited select customers to test Private Inference, which isolates customer data while the model runs so even internal employees cannot view it, with only a few customers in the trial. (AIbase)

item.title: Character.AI’s plan to auction off users’ private chats challenged by state AGs
item.description: State attorneys general are challenging Character.AI’s proposed bankruptcy sale of users’ private chats because it would transfer sensitive personal data from more than 21 million U.S. accounts, including 2.1 million registered to minors. (TechCrunch AI)

item.title: OpenAI begins merging ChatGPT's chat and work modes, with heavy users' advanced reasoning allowances potentially capped
item.description: On November 25, OpenAI began rolling out a unified Chat and Work experience to some ChatGPT Pro members, expanding in December, with shared usage meaning frequent advanced-reasoning users may hit limits sooner while Instant Mode remains unlimited. (AIbase)

item.title: Canva MCP — Turn any AI agent into a creative powerhouse
item.description: Canva MCP is presented as a way to turn any AI agent into a creative powerhouse, but the source body returns 403 Forbidden and needs JavaScript and cookies enabled. (Product Hunt)

item.title: Opus 5.6 Reportedly Surfaces in Claude API; User Tests Find Training Data Updated Through May 2026
item.description: A user on X claims the normal Claude interface returned replies from an unreleased Anthropic model dubbed Opus 5.6 and Sonnet 5.6, with Cheddar Lua noting mentions of May 2026 information, though Anthropic hasn't confirmed and Matt Berman publicly denied it. (AIbase)

item.title: 3way.Social MCP — Ask your AI to find link partners. You approve the deals.
item.description: 3way.Social MCP pitches a workflow where your AI surfaces link partners while you keep final approval on every deal, though the page itself returns only a security-verification screen. (Product Hunt)

item.title: SpaceX cuts Blackwell chip rental prices by up to 35%, with H200s returned by Anthropic subleased at low rates
item.description: Semiconductor research firm SemiAnalysis reports SpaceX cut small-scale Blackwell GPU hourly rentals to $10–12, a reduction of up to 35%, and is subletting H200 chips returned by Anthropic at low prices. (AIbase)

item.description: Anthropic's short version of the GRH Lean verification (github.com)

item.title: OpenAI cuts GPT-6.2 usage: Astra hits limits 40% faster, Sol 25% faster
item.description: OpenAI cuts GPT-6.2 usage: Astra hits limits 40% faster, Sol 25% faster

item.title: Valuation up by half in three months: AI voice company ElevenLabs in early talks for 2027 funding at a $33 billion target
item.description: ElevenLabs has opened preliminary talks for a new round targeting a $33 billion valuation, up from $22 billion in September, with annual recurring revenue rising from $600 million to $700 million ahead of a planned Q1 2027 launch. (AIbase)

item.title: Amazon in talks with Meta to open up shopping to Muse AI agent
item.description: Amazon is negotiating with Meta to let Meta's Muse AI agent shop on its e-commerce platform, with Fortune reporting talks center on which products get recommended and effects on ad revenue and customer relationships, after Amazon blocked Perplexity's agent. (AIbase)
